pr_title: Fix spinbox decimal issues when `update_on_text_changed` = true
pr_body:

Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/100620

When using `update_on_text_changed`:

If `.` is entered as the first character, automatically change to `0.`
Text ending in `.` does not get submitted, unless "accepted". 
Round numbers do not automatically have a decimal appended to it, unless "accepted". 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5328a735-9cd1-41ec-8ab4-52699fd8f1c6
pr_comments: `,` is also supported in SpinBox, so you should probably account for that too.

>, is also supported in SpinBox, so you should probably account for that too.

Done.

When the number ends with period and you press Enter, the period will disappear resulting in wrong text. Pressing Enter again will update it correctly.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e05a8259-001c-4ef8-9908-fd7c880b6e6c

> When the number ends with period and you press Enter, the period will disappear resulting in wrong text. Pressing Enter again will update it correctly.

Fixed.

The initial value is missing trailing 0 for some reason.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ea9c258-d4ff-4dd3-bbc5-b0adf2a70432)
Expected:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb2c67c3-0bdb-4ca5-8c22-bf3a59ecd76f)

>The initial value is missing trailing 0 for some reason.

Fixed.

issue_context.title: SpinBox `update_on_text_changed = true` regression: Can't input decimals.
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable, v4.4.dev6 [1f47e4c4e]
- Not reproducible in: v4.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6603) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

Setting `Update on Text Changed` to true prevents decimals from being input. It seems to be similar to what happened with #81989. You can copy and paste decimal numbers into the SpinBox just fine, but trying to type a decimal will do nothing. Changing `step` to a decimal value < 1 still doesn't allow a decimal to be typed. This is true for both GDscript and C# in 4.3 & 4.4-dev6, but not in 4.2 (as #81989 fixed it in that version)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene
2. Add a SpinBox node
3. Set `Update on Text Changed` to true
4. Run the current scene
5. Type decimal (.) into the SpinBox

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5d72dd2-0f75-4404-b0cc-b51aa0d23769)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
comments:
SpinBoxes have a lot of issues, as I mentioned [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11395)

You can use an alternative to SpinBox I made:

[spinner.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18209277/spinner.zip)
Submitted a PR (linked above), that should fix this.

review_comments: It was meant to revert the text, which indeed does seem to work without that line. What might've happened is that the reverting stopped working while my PR was WIP, so I added that line to fix it. Then when my PR was functional I didn't try to remove it.
